patchNotes:
## v0.1.13 - Dungeon Atmosphere and Smarter Parties

**TLDR:** Dungeons now feel alive - animated water, floating particles, flickering light on your heroes, and cinematic vignette edges. Your AI party members are dramatically better at following you through corridors instead of getting stuck behind walls. Leaders who die are properly replaced so your team keeps moving.

**Visual Upgrades**
- Flooded dungeon floors now shimmer with animated water caustics and ripple effects
- Each dungeon theme has unique floating ambient particles - embers in the Catacombs, ash in the Undercroft, bubbles in the Drowned Sanctum, snowflakes in the Frozen Crypt, spores in the Fungal Grotto
- Heroes standing near torches, braziers, and ritual circles now glow with warm nearby light
- Cinematic vignette darkening around screen edges while dungeon crawling

**Party AI Overhaul**
- Followers now form a trailing column behind the leader instead of all crowding the same tile
- Party members no longer freeze behind corners and walls in narrow corridors
- When your leader dies mid-dungeon, a follower is properly promoted and continues exploring
- Heroes pathfind through doors much more reliably instead of routing around them
- Fixed multiple causes of heroes getting permanently stuck or bouncing in place

**Exploration Fixes**
- Leaders no longer waste dozens of turns staring at a door without opening it
- Rooms blocked by temporary enemy congestion no longer get permanently marked as unreachable
- Smarter room-skip system that escalates timeouts instead of giving up forever
- Directed patrol movement toward unexplored areas instead of wandering randomly
